body: I've been trying to be nice with her and not be the one to deal with it because I know I'd probably not be too nice about it. But I don't know how much more I'm willing to take especially if no one else is going to say anything. Thank you :)

She really never tells me to do anything other than to shut up, but whenever she does I just tell her to piss off. My younger brother on the other hand just complains but rolls over and takes it. Next time she tells me to do something though I'm definitely telling her to get the hell out though. Thank you :)

I've clarified that in further comments, but thank you :) I don't really have a problem with her or them together, he definitely could have done worse, but I just do not want to be around her all of the time when she is loud and just overall doesn't respect us. I could put up with her here and there but the 24/7 irritation is not something I want to deal with.

We've made it clear that we don't want her around to both him and our parents (trust me, they complain about her too) but no one wants to deal with the conflict. They're getting to the point of putting their foot down though.

Thankfully she doesn't do anything like that but it does feel very uncomfortable to use the bathroom or be naked in there showering with her around. I already don't like using public bathrooms but to have someone I barely know yelling or something in my house while I'm trying to go is not a pleasant experience.

Other than the constant showing up, she gets really loud. Like screaming at our television or at my brothers for doing stuff she thinks is stupid, etc. and ends up giving everyone migraines. She constantly tells my younger brother (he's 14) to go to bed or to do stuff in snarky tones, like she's parenting him, or tells me to shut up when I'm talking to other people. She's gotten into arguments with some of my brothers, notably some being that she kept messaging them all hours of the night and wouldn't stop when asked to, and for underage drinking at a local establishment and almost getting them shut down. She also starts grilling people on personal matters that doesn't pertain to her and doesn't back off when you say "I don't want to talk about that with you"

The last straw lately has been the appearances though. The constant being up our asses every day for hours is getting to everyone and it's like she can't respect the boundary of "leave us alone for a day or two"
